### Water from the Rock
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/water-from-the-rock
Passage: Exodus 17:6
Points:
- Walking by faith often leads through difficult wilderness trials designed to deepen our dependence on God.
- Instead of trusting the Lord's proven faithfulness, Israel grumbled and put God on trial.
- God showed mercy by standing upon the rock before the people to receive the strike of the rod.
- The struck rock foreshadows Jesus Christ bearing divine judgment so that life-giving spiritual water could flow to His people.

### A Prayer for When the Path is Unknown
Author: Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-when-the-path-is-unknown.html
Passage: Exodus 17:1-2
Points:
- God frequently directs His people along unexpected paths rather than according to our own neat plans.
- Israel arrived at a waterless camp by God's direct command rather than by an accidental mistake.
- In uncomfortable circumstances, people often react by assuming God is distant or by quarreling with leadership.
- Believers are invited to move past bitter complaints and trust that God remains faithfully present to provide.
